findings.text: non-blocking: dropping the 'previous is None and not inspected' early return makes a project holding no retained tree read its whole history on every signature change, and reckon/crew/merge.py:1544 calls _held_worktree_records on every landing, so a landing in a repository with no retained trees now pays a run-history read it did not pay before, with no measurement of that cost in the manifest.

non-blocking: the section duty's candidate population now comes from the held-record pass's index (ledger.runs/open_runs plus the aggregate) instead of ledger.load's own store read, and no assertion in tests/test_fleet_state_reuses_its_reads_between_ticks.py compares the two populations, so a drift between the rows handed over and the reader that was replaced would be silent.

justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the node's three commits (reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, reckon/crew/section_obligations.py, the test file, the fragment directory) sits inside the declared write paths, though the recorded diff range also carries three commits of the queue-ordering landing that precede them.
